Title: Time of day
Description: Set the time, or pause and resume the clock.

Inputs.Description: Connect to the Body pin of a Passage, Option, Branch or Alternative. Statements run in the order of their links.

Options.Label: Time
Options.Description: dawn, noon, dusk, midnight, an hour 0-24, pause or resume.

Options.Label: Fade seconds
Options.Description: Fade over this many seconds; empty for instant.
